message: Please enter your Prolific ID below:

Welcome to "Asteroid Fortune Frontier" the asteroid mining adventure.

 PLEASE READ CAREFULLY: 

  As a player you will pilot a starship to mine ASTEROIDS with by shooting them. Some asteroids yield rewards more often than others. These reward rates are unknown to you. 

YOUR GOAL IS FIND THE ASTEROID THAT YIELDS REWARD MOST OFTEN AND MINE FROM IT AS MUCH AS POSSIBLE!  

 You will also encounter several asteroid ZONES. The zone number will be displayed on the screen to tell you what zone you are in. Sometimes you will repeat the same zone and will experience the same unknown reward payoffs as before giving you more opportunity to mine from the same asteroids. However when you move into new zones the asteroids will change and so will their unknown reward payoffs requiring you to explore again to discover the best asteroids to mine from.

 You will also have starship PARTNERS to watch and learn from. Pay close attention as you might learn something valuable that may ultimately help you find the most rewarding asteroids to mine from.  

Welcome to "Asteroid Fortune Frontier" – where the universe is yours to mine.

[RED_BOLD]DO NOT RELOAD PAGE AT ANY TIME DURING GAME![/RED_BOLD]

instructions.instruction6: You mine rewards from asteroids by shooting them. Some asteroids yield reward more often than others. Get optimal rewards by finding the asteroids that yield reward often!

You mine rewards from asteroids by shooting them. Some asteroids yield reward more often than others. To get optimal rewards find the asteroids that yield rewards most often and mine from them as much as you can!
